Needs changes before merge. This is a safety-tier review.

This is the first review with a reviewer marker. I read the complete diff against the current upstream main.
The earlier request to merge main is still applicable. The branch now conflicts with newer main.

Requested before merge:

1. Class: cache invalidation. `crates/app/src/operation/params/cutting.rs:46`: Include the Centre run-out clearance in the generation stamp. The generator uses this value. An independent probe changed only `clearance` from 1 to 3 mm. Both Centre stamps were `2504572616289204223`. The Left control produced different stamps. The Centre path can remain current after its run-out distance changes. Add a Centre test to `wire_stamp` that checks stale status after this edit and after a project reload.

2. Class: overlap bounds. `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/ring.rs:176`: Complete the stated overlap or refuse it. The loop visits only `n` vertices and omits the final segment back to the seam. With the PR's 40 x 20 mm die fixture, a 100 mm overlap produces only 98.845 mm. A 1000 mm overlap produces the same extension. Both calls succeed. The note still states the requested distance. Include the remaining seam segment. Refuse lengths beyond the supported limit. Test both directions and overlaps near the perimeter.

3. Class: pass boundaries and verification. `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/skims.rs:126`: Make open skims usable through verification and posting. The appended pass starts outside the stock at the opposite end from the previous pass. No move or pass boundary represents the new threading. The Centre fixture with one S21 skim generates, but `judge` returns `Unreadable("move 4 does not start where the move before it ended")`. The new refusal in `crates/sim/src/verify/wire/mod.rs:261` also rejects every open skim. Represent the pass boundaries and verify each pass at its own kerf. Add an app test that generates, verifies, and posts an open run with a skim.

4. Class: unsupported parameter combinations. `crates/app/src/operation/wire_op.rs:349`: Refuse an unsupported nonzero overlap before generation. Burnout and 4-axis generation receive this field but ignore it. Independent probes gave identical moves for overlap 0 and 1 mm in both modes. The operation and the UI accept the value. Implement the overlap or reject these combinations at the command door. Add tests for each combination.

5. Class: path transformation. `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/mod.rs:318`: Do not pass an overlapped lap to the taper builder as a simple ring. `taper.rs:140` removes two endpoints and assumes the remaining points form one ring. With the die fixture, a 3-degree taper succeeds at overlap 0. At overlap 1 mm, it fails with `the wire path repeats a point - it cannot be leaned`. Preserve the original ring and apply the overlap after taper generation, or refuse this unsupported combination at the command door. Add a test.

6. Class: integration conflicts. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149`, `crates/app/tests/wire_verify.rs:78`, and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:195`: Merge current upstream main without losing either side's changes. The local trial merge has conflicts in these three files. It cannot establish a build result against current main.

7. Class: UI evidence. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:203` / PR body: Add before and after screenshots of the changed Wire Contour controls. The body has no screenshots. Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

8. Class: process metadata. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:149` / PR body: Add the exact line `Process change: yes`. This PR edits a process file. Current upstream `AGENTS.md` requires this line. Do not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded program, fixture, or golden file changed. The golden test changes only add the default overlap field.

Local validation:

- PR head: `f019072d8097f1d464501eeb610c62ea3cb6f3aa`.
- Main used for the trial merge and the laws: `ea19c3f2167e20f1ea1328563ed29c0e066591da`.
- The trial merge failed in the three files above. I aborted it without resolving code. Tests below ran on the PR head. There is no successful trial-merge commit whose first parent can be checked.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 713 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. Wall time: 52.8 minutes. This includes the touched sim, motion, app, and UI builds and suites.
- Sim lib: 242 passed. Motion lib: 621 passed, 22 ignored. App lib: 306 passed. UI lib: 1588 passed, 8 ignored.
- All three motion pins passed. `mcp_wire_contour` passed all 8 tests. The UI overlap apply/undo pin passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run:

- The quick plan ran each catalog suite by name: `example_catalog` (41 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` (1 passed), and `example_catalog_edge_work` (1 passed).
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed. The quick plan also ran the wire posting, verification, stamp, and controller suites.
- No fixture data or importer source changed. The extra kernel STEP and mesh suites do not apply.

Source mutations:

I used disposable source copies in `/tmp`. I did not change the PR worktree's source.

- Remove `ring::past_seam` from the generated lap: the overlap pin failed at `tests.rs:361`. The final cut remained at X0 instead of X-1.
- Change the Centre offset sign from 0 to 1: the centre-line pin failed at `open_tests.rs:138`. The path ran at X59.835 instead of X60.
- Both pins passed before mutation. Both passed again after restoration. The first control build needed a shared fixture helper copied into the temporary tree. That setup error was corrected before these runs.

Independent input probes also checked negative overlap and a reversed open skim. Both were refused by name. The behavior findings above include the other probe results.

Light lane: `cargo xtask gate light` passed all 6 steps and all 11 selected tests. The motion lib step passed 7 tests. The island, neck, parallel, and app pocket-start steps each passed 1 test. No step failed or stalled. Full heavy lanes were not run, as current upstream law requires for this review.

The worktree and `review-3617` branch remain in place for the next round. No code or review evidence was committed or pushed.

Labels: `needs-rework` and `conflicts`. The PR remains in its author-selected ready state.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: all eight items of the safety review are on the new head b202b7efb, pushed to the same branch. The PR keeps its ready flag and waits for a fresh review.

1. Cache invalidation - implemented: the Centre side now digests the run-out clearance (`crates/app/src/operation/params/cutting.rs`); the new `wire_stamp` centre test pins Stale after the clearance edit and after a project reload.
2. Overlap bounds - implemented: `past_seam` rides the seam edge's own remainder back to the seam (`crates/motion/src/wire_edm/ring.rs`), so a 100 mm overlap covers exactly 100.000 mm of arc, forward and reversed; a ride longer than one full lap is refused by name. Motion tests cover both directions and overlaps near the perimeter.
3. Pass boundaries - implemented: a travel move (a rapid, no wire through it) marks each pass boundary; the wire verify splits at the boundaries and judges each pass at its own kerf and its own ends (`sim` `passes::split_open`); the post announces each skim after the travel, and `wire-iso.cps` cuts the wire, travels and threads anew. A new app test generates, verifies AND posts an open run with a skim against a new golden (`wire_contour_open_skims.nc`).
4. Unsupported combinations - refused by name at the command door: `wire_op::overlap_refusal` through `condition_of` names the pair for the burnout (`wire_burnout` pins the create and edit doors) and the 4-axis cut (`wire_4axis` pins both).
5. Taper overlap - refused by name at the same door: the 3 degree taper at overlap 1 mm now refuses at creation and edit with the pair named (`wire_taper`), never inside the taper builder with "repeats a point"; the same overlap on the vertical cut still rides its seam.
6. The merge - resolved keeping both sides: the SKILL.md line is main's text plus the overlap field, `wire_verify.rs`'s helper takes main's picks fields plus `overlap: 0.0`, and `wire_page.rs` keeps the closing-overlap row and the centre hints with main's start group; main's new arc modules and arc tests take the Centre side and the overlap field. The resolved tree builds and its gates ran green (the body lists them).
7. Screenshots - before and after of the changed Wire Contour controls, images only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, are linked in the body: the controls pair and the full-window pair.
8. Process line - the body carries the exact line `Process change: yes`; `PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched.

The choice per item (items 2 and 3 implemented as defects of what the feature claims; items 4 and 5 refused by name at the door) is recorded in `docs/decisions/3216-wire-overlap-rework.md`. Gates on the resolved tree: motion lib 654, sim lib 253, app lib 310, ui lib 1649, `mcp_wire_contour` 8, `wire_verify` 3, `golden_cl` 34, the touched wire suites, `conformance` 7 and clippy clean; `example_catalog`'s drill-overfeed refusal.txt red is the known environmental #3628.
